First browser run timed out in the readiness probe with self-hostname resolution warnings and no OOM. A workspace-only harness explicitly set SE_NODE_HOST=127.0.0.1 and retried transient probe timeouts within the unchanged readiness deadline; final ZIP bytes were unchanged. In lifecycle-02 fresh passed but the later upgrade browser login field was absent; original cause remains undetermined. A workspace harness added a bounded element wait and diagnostics, then repeated only upgrade in lifecycle-03. No assertion was removed.
